mechanism: Chlorthalidone causes electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hyponatremia) and volume depletion which increases risk of syncope and arrhythmias; galantamine enhances vagal tone and can cause bradycardia and hypotension, compounding cardiovascular and electrolyte risks.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes, blood pressure, and heart rate regularly; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative antihypertensive if syncope or significant bradycardia develops; educate patient on orthostatic precautions.
